videosPerChannel.label: Videos Per Channel
videosPerChannel.description: How many recent uploads to pull from each channel on a refresh. Higher values follow more continuations, so a refresh takes longer and makes more requests.

retentionDays.label: Keep Videos For (Days)
retentionDays.description: Videos older than this are dropped from the cache on each refresh. Only the cache is pruned: your watched history is never pruned, so a video that drops out and later returns is still known to be watched. Set to 0 to keep everything.

refreshIntervalHours.label: Hours Between Automatic Refreshes
refreshIntervalHours.description: Opening this widget refreshes the feed only if this many hours have passed. There is no background sync: YouTube.js runs only in the browser, so refreshes happen while the widget is open. Set to 0 to refresh only with the Refresh button.

markWatchedOnPlay.label: Mark Watched When Played
markWatchedOnPlay.description: Mark a video watched as soon as it starts playing. Off by default, since the embedded player cannot report how much of a video was actually watched.

hideShorts.label: Hide Shorts
hideShorts.description: Leave YouTube Shorts out of the feed. Also toggled directly on the Feed tab. Shorts are detected by duration, so a Short longer than a minute reads as a normal video.

viewFilter.label: Last Watch Filter
viewFilter.description: Remembered Feed view state. Managed by the widget, not edited here.

viewChannel.label: Last Channel Filter
viewChannel.description: Remembered Feed view state. Managed by the widget, not edited here.

viewSortDesc.label: Last Sort Direction
viewSortDesc.description: Remembered Feed view state. Managed by the widget, not edited here.
